ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 2:98 ratio of high-intensity (white/glare) to low-intensity (black/pigment) pixels; the surface is near-uniformly low-intensity.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate internal angle of 45 degrees and a distinct vertical bisection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along both lobes; right lobe contains a deep, irregular U-shaped indentation in the distal third; left lobe shows more uniform saw-tooth peak-to-valley transitions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve sweeping upward from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast textured clusters of brownish-grey pixels located at the lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive epibiont/barnacle colonization on both fluke tips; irregular traumatic indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity vertical drainage streak of water descending from the median notch.
